description: Deterministically resolve a folder, create a new playlist, and add every CONVERTED video to it in folder order. dry_run=true (default) previews the playlist and its videos without creating anything.

access_type.description: Playlist access type (the Panda API requires it; defaults to anyone_with_link)

creator_name.description: Creator name shown in the player (the Panda API requires it; defaults to the playlist name)

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

name: panda_action_create_playlist_from_folder
title: Create Playlist from Folder
